temperature_source: one temperature fitted by NLL on a 10,013-question calibration split (every track, never trained on); on a 2,388-question validation split it lowers ECE from 0.0293 to 0.0240; accuracy unchanged

training.data: 190,296 questions from 155 decision tracks (public + synthetic decision mix, one epoch)
training.method: full fine-tune of blocks 1-16 (332M parameters, fp32) + scalar head; embeddings frozen
